candidate_name: North Pars field development (domestic gas; possible future LNG component)
sponsor_or_proposer: Pars Oil and Gas Co (POGC) / National Iranian Oil Co
current_state: Iran has revived development of the North Pars FIELD itself for domestic gas supply — the offshore-technology field profile (operator Pars Oil and Gas; announced 2007) shows the project at the approval stage with production expected from 2026 (Wayback snapshot verified 2026-01-03; live page bot-blocks with HTTP 403). No LNG/export component in the current revival — the 2006-era CNOOC-NIOC North Pars LNG plan stays cancelled.
missing_threshold_elements: No LNG or marine-export component — currently out of scope (domestic gas only); no sponsor commitment to liquefaction, no site, no offtake.
watch_for: Any announcement re-attaching a liquefaction/export component to North Pars gas. Per the dead-and-revived rule, that would be staged as a NEW terminal (AssociatedTerminals → T100000130584), NOT as a status change to the cancelled North Pars LNG Terminal record — unless it is demonstrably the same CNOOC-era 4-train project resumed.
